title: SpecialRoles plugin
description: A Spigot/Paper plugin for simple roles in Minecraft!
body:
Only op players can use these commands, here are all of them:

/role give <player> <role> <level>

- gives the specified player a role and a level
- 
/role clear <player>
- 
- clears the existing role from the specified player
- 
/role check <player>
- 
- checks the role of the specified player
- 
/role msg <role> <message>
- 
- messages all players with the specified role;

You can edit the roles in **plugins\special-roles\config.yml**;

(A level can be use to know how important is a role, for example the owner could be level 1, the VIP and OP roles could be level 2 while normal players are level 3)
